statements.syncPushAckDeleteByObject: DELETE FROM sync_push_ack WHERE object_type = ? AND object_id = ?
statements.syncPushAckDeleteIssuesByObject: DELETE FROM sync_push_ack WHERE object_type = ? AND object_id = ? AND status IN ('conflict', 'rejected')
statements.syncPushAckUpsert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_push_ack (client_op_id, object_type, object_id, state_seq, status, acked_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
statements.syncPushAckTableExists: SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'sync_push_ack' LIMIT 1
statements.syncReviewLogInsert: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO review_log (id, op_id, device_id, node_id, grade, scheduler_version, reviewed_at, due_before, stability_before, difficulty_before, due_after, stability_after, difficulty_after) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
statements.syncNodeReadingUpsert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO node_reading (node_id, interval_duration_ms, interval_growth_factor, last_handled_at, next_at, priority, repetition_count, state) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
statements.syncNodeReadingDeviceStateUpsert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO node_reading_device_state (node_id, device_id, reading_position, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
statements.syncNodeReviewUpsert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO node_review (node_id, due, last_review_at, state, stability, difficulty, elapsed_days, scheduled_days, reps, lapses) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
statements.syncSettingRecordUpsert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO setting_records (key, scope, platform, form_factor, device_id, value_json, content_hash, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
statements.syncViewActiveNodeUpsert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO workspace_meta (key, value, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
statements.syncViewNodeStateDelete: DELETE FROM node_view_state WHERE node_id = ? AND device_id = ?
statements.syncViewNodeStateUpsert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO node_view_state (node_id, device_id, scroll_top, selection_from, selection_to, source, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
statements.syncExternalDocumentMarkMissing: UPDATE external_documents SET is_present = 0, missing_at = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE document_id = ?
statements.syncExternalDocumentUpsert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO external_documents (document_id, folder_id, relative_path, file_name, extension, source_size_bytes, source_modified_at, source_modified_ms, content_hash, title, opening_text, body_blob_hash, content, indexed_at, is_present, missing_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
statements.textBodyBlobManifestInsert: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO content_blobs (hash, storage_key, kind, mime_type, compression, original_size_bytes, stored_size_bytes, original_sha256, stored_sha256, availability, created_at, cached_at, last_verified_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
statements.textBodyBlobDataInsert: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO content_blob_data (hash, data) VALUES (?, ?)
statements.nodeAttachmentUpsert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO node_attachments (node_id, attachment_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
statements.attachmentResourceMarkCached: UPDATE attachment_blobs SET storage_key = ?, availability = 'cached', cached_at = ?, last_verified_at = ? WHERE attachment_id = ?
statements.attachmentResourceMarkFailed: UPDATE attachment_blobs SET availability = 'failed' WHERE attachment_id = ?
statements.contentBlobDataReplace: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO content_blob_data (hash, data) VALUES (?, ?)
statements.contentBlobMarkCached: UPDATE content_blobs SET availability = 'cached', cached_at = ?, last_verified_at = ? WHERE hash = ?
statements.contentBlobMarkFetching: UPDATE content_blobs SET availability = 'fetching' WHERE hash = ?
statements.contentBlobMarkFailed: UPDATE content_blobs SET availability = 'failed' WHERE hash = ?
statements.syncStateExisting: SELECT content_hash, base_content_hash, sync_dirty FROM sync_object_state WHERE object_type = ? AND object_id = ? LIMIT 1
statements.syncStateNextSeq: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(state_seq), 0) + 1 AS next_state_seq FROM sync_object_state
statements.syncStateUpsert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_object_state (object_type, object_id, state_seq, current_version_id, content_hash, base_content_hash, last_modified_by_device_id, updated_at, deleted_at, sync_dirty) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
